offers_products.reason: Supermarket chain selling groceries, bakery items, and also owns milk processing and fuel/convenience; goods are the main offering.

offers_services.reason: Pharmacy and bakery ordering are incidental to retail grocery sales; no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Supermarkets sell groceries, cakes and pharmacy items to households shopping in Southeast stores.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Revenue is overwhelmingly retail shoppers; small milk-processing sales to others are minor.

recurring_revenue.reason: Households repeatedly buy groceries, pharmacy items and fuel weekly.

cyclical_demand.reason: Groceries and pharmacy items are necessities that customers keep buying in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Typical grocery basket is small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for groceries and goods sold through stores, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households shopping at its supermarkets.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many owned supermarkets, distribution centers and a milk plant; growth needs ongoing real estate and store investment.
